release_notes: Three layout refinements to the Ready Messages log on top of 1.0.64. (1) Bodies are now center-aligned on a single vertical midline so when the font grows (12pt bold for the previous incoming Ready, 15pt bold for the newest) the body extends both LEFT and RIGHT of the line above it instead of just to the right. Implemented via a center-aligned tab stop at the widget's vertical midline; every line starts with a tab character to land its body on that stop. (2) Timestamps are no longer all the way at the right edge of the widget — they now sit just past the widest body's right edge with a small gap, so the timestamp column reads close to the bodies instead of floating off to the right. The right-aligned tab stop is recomputed dynamically as new bodies arrive (monotonic-grow within a session; resets on midnight rollover). (3) Thin gray horizontal lines now separate adjacent log entries — below every entry except the very last one — so it's easy to scan which timestamp belongs to which line. Implemented as embedded tk.Frame widgets via text.window_create, with widths resyncing on every Configure event. The canonical persisted log line format is now '\tbody\t[ts]'; the existing _migrate_old_log_line helper grows another case so pre-1.0.62, 1.0.62, and 1.0.64 entries all migrate to the new canonical form on the next launch.
